V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The central oval court is bounded by the building on the left and a long wall on the right, but is open at the top and bottom. The patio is enclosed on three sides by the building and walls.

V-FOCAL.evidence: Large central 'olive' tree in the oval court is significantly larger than the two smaller 'Punica' trees, establishing a clear primary focal point.

V-AXIS.evidence: Entry deck leads to the central oval court and patio; the court is anchored by the large citrus tree and flanked by the patio and lawn areas.

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Six identical medium-green circles (small trees) are repeated in a continuous row along the bottom boundary, and two identical 'Punica' trees are repeated in the upper right.

V-LAYERING.evidence: Plan shows canopy trees (large dark circles) in the central court, small trees (medium circles) along the bottom edge, and ground cover/perennials (pale circles) at the bottom right, indicating three distinct planting layers.

V-ROOMS.evidence: Plan shows a paved patio, a central lawn oval court with a tree, a separate entry deck, and a planting bed along the street, creating distinct zones with different surfaces and uses.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear zoning into a central oval court, flanking hatched building masses, a defined patio, and a structured entry deck with a linear planting mass along the street edge.
